prompt: snowy mountain platformer — slope-blended snow, ice, and rock terrain; stone block platforms; pale grey-blue night sky with stars
script:
-- Frostpeak Ascent - snowy mountain platformer

local platforms = {}
local checkpoints = {}
local hazards = {}
local yetis = {}
local lastCheckpoint = {x=0, y=2, z=-30}
local gameWon = false

Game.OnStart(function()
  -- Pale grey-blue starry night sky
  Scene.SetCustomSkybox({
    topColor = {0.08, 0.12, 0.22},
    bottomColor = {0.18, 0.24, 0.36},
    horizonColor = {0.45, 0.55, 0.70},
    groundColor = {0.85, 0.92, 0.98},
    sunColor = {0.75, 0.82, 0.95},
    sunDirection = {25, 200, 0},
    sunSize = 0.03,
    sunIntensity = 0.6,
    exposure = 1.0,
    atmosphereThickness = 1.4,
    fogColor = {0.55, 0.65, 0.78},
    fogDensity = 0.012,
    ambientColor = {0.55, 0.65, 0.80},
    ambientIntensity = 0.7,
    starDensity = 0.9,
    cloudDensity = 0.3,
    timeOfDay = "night",
  })
  Scene.SetGravity(-12)

  -- Slope-blended snow/ice/rock terrain
  Structure.CreateTerrain(0, 0, 0, 200, 200, {
    { materialType = "snow", slopeMin = 0.0,  slopeMax = 0.30, tiling = 10.0 },
    { materialType = "ice",  slopeMin = 0.20, slopeMax = 0.55, tiling = 8.0 },
    { materialType = "rock", slopeMin = 0.50, slopeMax = 1.0,  tiling = 6.0 },
  })

  -- Perimeter walls (icy stone)
  local wallColor = {0.55, 0.62, 0.72}
  local w1 = Structure.CreateWall(  0, 5,  45, 90, 10,  0, wallColor)
  local w2 = Structure.CreateWall(  0, 5, -45, 90, 10,  0, wallColor)
  local w3 = Structure.CreateWall( 45, 5,   0, 90, 10, 90, wallColor)
  local w4 = Structure.CreateWall(-45, 5,   0, 90, 10, 90, wallColor)
  w1:SetMaterial("ice", 4.0, 0.4)
  w2:SetMaterial("ice", 4.0, 0.4)
  w3:SetMaterial("ice", 4.0, 0.4)
  w4:SetMaterial("ice", 4.0, 0.4)

  -- Player setup
  Player.SetSpeed(6)
  Player.SetJumpHeight(4)
  Player.SetSpawnPoint(0, 2, -30)
  Player.SetHealth(100)

  -- Audio + music
  Audio.PlayMusic("adventure")
  Audio.PlaySound("ambient_cave")

  -- Base camp pad (start area)
  local stoneColor = {0.45, 0.50, 0.58}
  local basePad = Structure.CreateBox(0, 0.5, -30, 12, 1, 8, stoneColor)
  basePad:SetMaterial("stone", 4.0, 0.7)
  basePad:SetStatic(true)

  -- Decorative pine trees around the base
  local pinePositions = {
    {-20, 0, -35}, {18, 0, -38}, {-30, 0, -20}, {28, 0, -15},
    {-35, 0, 5}, {32, 0, 8}, {-25, 0, 30}, {25, 0, 32}
  }
  for _, p in ipairs(pinePositions) do
    local pine = Object.Create("model:pine_tree")
    pine:SetPosition(p[1], p[2], p[3])
    pine:SetScale(2.5, 3, 2.5)
    pine:SetStatic(true)
  end

  -- Climbing platforms - stone blocks going up the mountain
  -- Format: {x, y, z, sx, sy, sz}
  local platformData = {
    {0,    2,   -20, 5, 1, 5},     -- 1 starter
    {-6,   3.5, -14, 4, 1, 4},     -- 2
    {2,    5,   -8,  4, 1, 4},     -- 3
    {-4,   6.5, -2,  3.5, 1, 3.5}, -- 4
    {5,    8,    3,  3.5, 1, 3.5}, -- 5 checkpoint
    {-3,   9.5,  9,  3, 1, 3},     -- 6
    {6,   11,   14,  3, 1, 3},     -- 7
    {-2,  12.5, 19,  3, 1, 3},     -- 8
    {8,   14,   23,  3, 1, 3},     -- 9 checkpoint
    {0,   15.5, 28,  3, 1, 3},     -- 10
    {-7,  17,   32,  3, 1, 3},     -- 11
    {3,   18.5, 36,  3.5, 1, 3.5}, -- 12
    {0,   20,   41,  6, 1, 6},     -- 13 summit pad
  }
  for i, p in ipairs(platformData) do
    local plat = Structure.CreateBox(p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4], p[5], p[6], stoneColor)
    plat:SetMaterial("stone", 3.0, 0.65)
    plat:SetStatic(true)
    platforms[i] = plat
  end

  -- Ice hazards on platforms (touching damages player)
  local hazardData = {
    {-5, 7,   -2}, -- on platform 4
    {4,  10,   9}, -- between platforms
    {-1, 13,  19}, -- on platform 8
    {7,  16,  28}, -- between 9 and 10
    {-6, 18,  32}, -- on platform 11
  }
  for i, hp in ipairs(hazardData) do
    local spike = Object.Create("model:ice_spike")
    spike:SetPosition(hp[1], hp[2], hp[3])
    spike:SetScale(1.2, 1.5, 1.2)
    spike:OnPlayerEnter(function()
      Player.AddHealth(-25)
      Audio.PlaySound("hit")
      Effects.ScreenShake(0.3, 0.2)
      Effects.Flash({r=0.5, g=0.7, b=1.0}, 0.2)
      Player.ShowMessage("Ouch! Icy spikes!", 1.5)
    end)
    hazards[i] = spike
  end

  -- Checkpoints (flags on key platforms)
  local checkpointData = {
    {x=5, y=9,  z=3,  name="Halfway up!"},
    {x=8, y=15, z=23, name="Almost there!"},
  }
  for i, cp in ipairs(checkpointData) do
    local flag = Object.Create("model:checkpoint_flag")
    flag:SetPosition(cp.x, cp.y, cp.z)
    flag:SetScale(1.5, 2, 1.5)
    flag:SetEmissive(1.0, 0.3, 0.3, 0.8)
    local reached = false
    flag:OnPlayerEnter(function()
      if reached then return end
      reached = true
      lastCheckpoint = {x=cp.x, y=cp.y + 1.5, z=cp.z}
      Audio.PlaySound("collect")
      Effects.Spawn("sparkle", cp.x, cp.y + 1, cp.z)
      Player.ShowMessage(cp.name .. " Checkpoint saved!", 2)
      Player.AddScore(100)
    end)
    checkpoints[i] = flag
  end

  -- Wandering yetis on a couple wider platforms (light obstacles)
  local yetiSpawns = {
    {x=5, y=9,  z=3,  range=2, dir=1},
    {x=0, y=21, z=41, range=3, dir=1},
  }
  for i, ys in ipairs(yetiSpawns) do
    local y = Object.Create("model:yeti")
    y:SetPosition(ys.x, ys.y, ys.z)
    y:SetScale(1, 1, 1)
    y.data = {baseX=ys.x, baseZ=ys.z, range=ys.range, dir=ys.dir, t=0, y=ys.y}
    y:OnPlayerEnter(function()
      Player.AddHealth(-15)
      Audio.PlaySound("hit")
      Effects.ScreenShake(0.4, 0.3)
      Player.ShowMessage("Yeti slap!", 1)
    end)
    yetis[i] = y
  end

  -- Summit shrine (goal)
  local shrine = Object.Create("model:shrine")
  -- Summit shrine sits atop the highest platform at (0, 20, 41); the goal frames the climb's reward
  shrine:SetPosition(0, 21, 41)
  shrine:SetScale(2.5, 3, 2.5)
  shrine:SetEmissive(0.3, 0.6, 1.0, 2.5)
  shrine:OnPlayerEnter(function()
    if gameWon then return end
    gameWon = true
    Player.AddScore(1000)
    Effects.Spawn("confetti", 0, 22, 41)
    Effects.Spawn("sparkle", 0, 22, 41)
    Audio.PlaySound("win")
    Player.ShowTitle("Summit Reached!", "You conquered Frostpeak!", 4)
    Timer.After(2, function() Game.End("win") end)
  end)

  -- Glowing summit light
  local summitLight = Light.Create("point", 0, 24, 41)
  summitLight:SetColor(0.4, 0.7, 1.0)
  summitLight:SetIntensity(3)
  summitLight:SetRange(20)

  -- Base camp light
  local baseLight = Light.Create("point", 0, 4, -30)
  baseLight:SetColor(1.0, 0.8, 0.5)
  baseLight:SetIntensity(2)
  baseLight:SetRange(15)

  -- HUD
  UI.ShowHUD({health=true, score=true, objective="Climb to the glowing summit shrine!"})
  Player.ShowTitle("Frostpeak Ascent", "Climb to the summit shrine!", 3)
end)

-- Main update loop
Game.OnUpdate(function(dt)
  if gameWon then return end

  -- Animate yetis (slight patrol)
  for _, y in ipairs(yetis) do
    y.data.t = y.data.t + dt
    local offset = math.sin(y.data.t * 1.2) * y.data.range
    local newX = y.data.baseX + offset
    y:SetPosition(newX, y.data.y, y.data.baseZ)
    -- Face direction of motion
    local lookX = y.data.baseX + math.cos(y.data.t * 1.2) * y.data.range
    y:LookAt(lookX, y.data.y, y.data.baseZ + 0.1)
  end

  -- Player fell off the mountain - respawn at last checkpoint
  local pos = Player.GetPosition()
  if pos.y < -3 then
    Player.Teleport(lastCheckpoint.x, lastCheckpoint.y, lastCheckpoint.z)
    Player.AddHealth(-10)
    Audio.PlaySound("lose")
    Effects.Flash({r=1.0, g=0.3, b=0.3}, 0.3)
    Player.ShowMessage("You fell! Returned to checkpoint.", 2)
  end
end)

Game.OnPlayerDied(function()
  Audio.PlaySound("lose")
  Effects.ScreenShake(0.6, 0.4)
  Effects.Flash({r=1.0, g=0.2, b=0.2}, 0.5)
  Player.SetHealth(100)
  Player.Teleport(lastCheckpoint.x, lastCheckpoint.y, lastCheckpoint.z)
  Player.ShowMessage("You froze! Try again.", 2)
end)
